meeting.title: 1:1 with Sharon
meeting.headline: Customer delays CS dashboard timeline due to warehouse migration issues
meeting.summary: The customer reported that the CS dashboard timeline has slipped due to the data team being blocked on the warehouse migration. This is the second time this has happened. The customer will escalate the issue to the data team lead and provide a new date by tomorrow. Additionally, the agent flagged the student account renewal for review due to a risk raised by Prabhav.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Quick check in. Where is the CS dashboard timeline you promised on the kickoff call?

utterances.speaker: Sharon
utterances.text: It slipped. The data team is blocked on the warehouse migration, so the portfolio changes will not reflect until next sprint.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: That is the second time the warehouse migration has blocked us. Who owns unblocking it?

utterances.speaker: Sharon
utterances.text: I will escalate it to the data team lead today and come back with a date by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rachita
utterances.text: Good. Also flag the student account renewal in your review, Prabhav raised a risk on it.
